url.task: sequence classification over the URL string
url.label_mapping: 0 good, 1 phishing (hard coded, model card labels are generic)
url.notes: Always pass the full URL including its scheme.

image.task: image embedding, scored zero-shot against a prompt set unless models/image_head.json is present

image_head: models/image_head.json (fitted logistic head installed, fitted_on 694 development linked cases, grouped 5-fold CV selected C=0.03; see evaluation/outputs/fitted/image_head.json)
fusion_config: models/fusion.json (fitted: method learned, thresholds low 0.3519 / high 0.7633, disagreement_gap 0.9967, platt calibration; unfitted default kept at models/fusion.default.json; see evaluation/outputs/fitted/fusion.json)
